title: Melba Massage — homepage mockups
question: Choose a composition, or describe what to combine or revise.

options.label: Editorial calm
options.thesis: Broad cream typographic opening with headline at left and smaller intro/CTA at right, followed by an edge-to-edge panoramic photograph below (no text over image).
options.viewport: STRUCTURE A: Broad cream typographic opening with headline at left and smaller intro/CTA at right, followed by an edge-to-edge panoramic photograph below (no text over image). Lower page uses asymmetric two-column session section, pale sage experience band, spacious personal introduction, final horizontal contact row. One dominant typographic opening, quiet supporting sections.

options.label: Your session first
options.thesis: Compact two-column opening, headline on cream left and photo right, then a very prominent generous full-width ruled session menu with four horizontal rows and durations right-aligned.
options.viewport: STRUCTURE B: Compact two-column opening, headline on cream left and photo right, then a very prominent generous full-width ruled session menu with four horizontal rows and durations right-aligned. Experience beneath in a wide pale sage section, personal introduction in an asymmetric cream band and final contact row. Session comparison is the main structural distinction.

options.label: A personal welcome
options.thesis: Large panoramic photo opening with a solid cream editorial text column occupying left 38 percent, image right 62 percent and fully clear face, tall but balanced.
options.viewport: STRUCTURE C: Large panoramic photo opening with a solid cream editorial text column occupying left 38 percent, image right 62 percent and fully clear face, tall but balanced. Beneath use a narrow left intro and wide right massage details column, then spacious three-part experience band, personal introduction, and pale sage contact closing section. Photo establishes the personal connection, restrained typography and generous pacing.
